payload.title: A publication without a mission still gets rule-based copy checks
payload.description:
Found on Data Parade (5.19.1): every editorial check fails with "Publication mission: expected exactly one current record, found 0." because the publication has no mission doctrine yet. The whole check errors, so even the rules-based (Humanus) copy checks, which do not need the mission, never run, and the newsroom shows "The check failed".

Behavior:
- No current publication mission or policy doctrine record (0): the rules lane still runs; the judgment (classifier) lane, which is given the mission and policy as context, is skipped. The skip is recorded in the EditorialCheckRun lanes and the newsroom shows "Mission-based checks skipped: this publication has no mission yet." instead of a failure.
- Exactly one current record: unchanged.
- More than one current record: still an error (ambiguous doctrine).
- Only the editorial check asks for this (getEditorialContext optionalPublicationDoctrine); research, reporting and assignment context keep requiring the doctrine.

```gherkin
Feature: Editorial checks for a publication without a mission

  Scenario: No current mission: rule checks run, judgment checks are skipped
    Given the publication has no current mission
    And the editorial check settings turn the classifier on with a 12 second deadline
    When an editor checks "This game-changing release." in section "engineering"
    Then the findings are for policies "no-hype"
    And Humanus was asked to run without the classifier
    And the classifier lane is skipped because the publication has no mission

  Scenario: The skip is stored with the checked version
    Given the publication has no current mission
    When the saved version of a story is checked
    Then the stored check run records the classifier lane as skipped

  Scenario: One current mission: judgment checks run as before
    Given the publication has one current mission
    And the editorial check settings turn the classifier on with a 12 second deadline
    When an editor checks "This game-changing release." in section "engineering"
    Then Humanus was asked to run the classifier with a 12 second deadline

  Scenario: Two current missions are still an error
    Given the publication has 2 current missions
    When an editor checks "This game-changing release." in section "engineering"
    Then the check fails with "expected exactly one current record, found 2"
```

Unit level: both context resolvers (TypeScript and Python) return missingPublicationDoctrine for 0 records only when asked, and raise for 0 when not asked and for more than one always; laneNotice shows the skipped message.
